answer: A lone signal crossing a canyon proves nothing, so admission should demand a work-bonded identity. First, the applicant computes a verifiable delay proof taking six hours on one CPU, bound to one hardware key. Second, it posts a 25-token refundable bond into the network vault, locked for 30 days. Third, it holds only probationary rights until a clean month unlocks the bond. Forging 10,000 identities would lock 250,000 tokens, about $1,250,000 at $5 each, and burn 60,000 CPU-hours. A sybil farm then faces a vault door that opens only after a long, costly climb.
